parts.label: Part 2
parts.article:
Good morning everyone. We are gathered today for the unveiling of our new fitness centre. Our business started in 2006 when we recognised the need for a new modern and affordable fitness centre for those living in the area. We pulled resources together and started a small centre just off this road to your left. We have been there over the years until we decided we needed more room and more facilities due to the increasing numbers. This new facility is estimated to contain at least a thousand people at a time and is equipped with the latest state-of-the-art fitness facilities you can think of.

From the entrance, just to your right, you would get to the meeting room where we hold team meetings sometimes. In the past, our customers usually came in through the West Gate and went to the first room on their left to exercise. Well, this room used to be the gym room but now it's the women's fitting room. Our female customers can change and try on clothes there. The gym room would be the big room on your right as you enter from the West Gate. It houses state-of-the-art gym equipment as well as provides an arena for working out. At the top right corner of the map, we have the men's fitting room where men can change with some privacy. Some squash members say they would like to have classes at the room between two fitting rooms as it would be more convenient to change after sweating. Well, we will have a discussion about it and inform you if any changes happen. Now, our squash court is still at the other wing situated directly opposite the West Gate. The larger building behind it is the largest in the state for skating courses. It provides adequate conditioning and the properly selected tracks for beginners.

Why invest a lot in fitness and sports? Well, we have observed that in our society, the rate at which people develop preventable diseases is alarming. Statistics show that there is a very strong link between sedentary lifestyle and these diseases. We have set up this centre to correct and combat it while making sure it is open, accessible and affordable to all. To develop overall strength in the individual, the fitness machines are built to help those who always complain of muscle weakness, to overcome their challenges. We also have rooms for mat exercises. Many people always think that such exercises are only good for limbs and shoulders. Well, actually for anyone who wants to have a flexible body, these exercises such as plank and crunches are a good choice. You don't need any high-end fitness equipment. We also have an expanse of space just behind the building that we use for cycling exercises. This sport is good to help develop strength in the legs and it is equally a good way of freeing the mind. Many members hope that such exercises will help them lose weight. I'm afraid they don't work that way. We offer aerobics for those interested in raising their heart rate. It is a great sport to train your mind and also makes blood flow more efficient and faster. Contrary to what most people think, weight training does little to help you lose weight, but it does help you develop solid mental coordination and to stay focused without getting distracted so easily. So as we unveil this centre today, we're glad that you can also be a part of this step in the right direction. Thank you all for honouring us.

analyses.content: 原文提到从正门入口（entrance）进去，就在你的右边（just to your right）就是会议室。
Speaker: From the entrance, just to your right, you would get to the meeting room where we hold team meetings sometimes.
地图右下角是 Entrance，进门右手边的 G 就是会议室。
Speaker: In the past, our customers usually came in through the West Gate and went to the first room on their left to exercise... now it's the women's fitting room.
地图中间左侧是 West Gate，进门往左看（即上方），第一个房间是 H。
原文说顾客通常从西门（West Gate）进，进门后左手边的第一个房间（first room on their left）以前是健身房，现在改成了女更衣室。
Speaker: The gym room would be the big room on your right as you enter from the West Gate.
从 West Gate 进来，往右看（即下方），那个大的长方形房间 C 就是健身房。
原文描述当你从西门（West Gate）进入时，右手边的大房间（big room on your right）就是健身房（Gym room/Fitness room）。
Speaker: At the top right corner of the map, we have the men's fitting room where men can change with some privacy.
直接定位地图的右上角，F 就在那个角落里。
原文明确指出在地图的右上角（top right corner）是男更衣室，男士可以在那里私密更换衣物。

Speaker: Now, our squash court is still at the other wing situated directly opposite the West Gate. (补充：Speaker 接着说 "The larger building behind it is the largest in the state for skating courses"，说明 B 后面那个更大的 A 是滑冰场，反证了 B 是壁球场)
West Gate 的正对面是 A 和 B 两个建筑，结合原文 "situated directly opposite"，B 是最直接对面的位置（或者理解为原文说是在另一侧翼，且 B 在 A 的前面/旁边，根据常规逻辑和地图布局，B通常指代较小的那个court，或者原文语境下直接指代B位置）。(注：结合地图，A是后面较大的滑冰场，B是前面的壁球场)
原文提到壁球场位于另一侧翼（other wing），直接面对/正对着西门（directly opposite the West Gate）。

analyses.content: 原文提到为了发展个人的整体力量（overall strength），健身器械（fitness machines）是专门为此建造的。
Speaker: To develop overall strength in the individual, the fitness machines are built to help those who always complain of muscle weakness, to overcome their challenges.
"Overall strength" 在原文和选项中完全重合，属于送分题。
Speaker: Well, actually for anyone who wants to have a flexible body, these exercises such as plank and crunches are a good choice.
原文提到 "limbs and shoulders"（选项A）是人们误以为（Many people always think）的好处，Speaker 纠正说是为了 flexibility。
原文指出对于想要拥有**柔韧身体（flexible body）**的人来说，垫上运动（mat exercises）如平板支撑和卷腹是很好的选择。
原文说单车课程（cycling exercises）有助于发展腿部力量（strength in the legs），即下肢（lower limbs）。
原文提到许多会员希望它能 "lose weight"（选项G），但演讲者明确说 "I'm afraid they don't work that way"（恐怕没用），所以 G 是干扰项。

This sport is good to help develop strength in the legs, and it is equally a good way of freeing the mind. Many members hope that such exercises will help them lose weight. I'm afraid they don't work that way.
Speaker: We offer aerobics for those interested in raising their heart rate.
"Raising their heart rate" 直接对应选项 B "increase heartbeat"。
原文说有氧运动（aerobics）是提供给那些有兴趣**提高心率（raising their heart rate）**的人的。

Speaker: Contrary to what most people think, weight training does little to help you lose weight, but it does help you develop solid mental coordination and to stay focused without getting distracted so easily.
"Stay focused" 对应选项 E "improve concentration"。原文再次否定了 "lose weight"（选项G），说举重对此帮助甚微（does little to help）。
原文提到举重训练（weight training）能帮助你发展稳固的心理协调能力并保持专注（stay focused），不容易分心。
